capabilities: Score selected text for AI-written likelihood
Highlight AI-looking sentences in the note
Rewrite the selection into more natural wording
extras: Free trial of 5,000 credits for 30 days with a verified, non-disposable email; prepaid credit packs are $10/$50/$200 and expire after 12 months. API key is stored in Obsidian secret storage and must be re-entered per device. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later for manual install. Sentence highlighting works only for English and Portuguese; Spanish and French get a whole-text verdict. Full-rewrite re-check applies only to English passages of at least 150 words with 80% English words.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to tell whether a passage reads as AI-written or to rewrite it into more natural wording.
summary: Plugin that checks selected text for AI-written patterns and rewrites it to sound more natural via the AI Checker Humanizer API.
